content.Guideline Overview: The document is a set of guidelines on the evaluation and management of patients with bradycardia and cardiac conduction delay, including device-based therapy and other treatments. It references various reports and guidelines from different cardiovascular organizations.
Key References: 2008 ACC/AHA/HRS Guidelines for bradycardia and conduction disorders.
2014 AHA/ACC Guideline for coronary artery bypass graft surgery.
2013 ACCF/AHA Guideline for heart failure management.
2013 ACC/AHA guideline on ST-elevation myocardial infarction management.
